The AI module was unavailable and the zone score fallback produced no actionable signals, indicating the fallback thresholds are too restrictive or the fallback logic is broken.

The regime was highly tradeable but the system completely failed to capitalize because the AI module was offline and the fallback mechanism generated nothing.
